description:
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning itself to your hand, untapping any creature.
Pay 2 life to cast Wirewood Symbiote.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Spike Feeder to activate it, gaining 2 life.
Resolve Wirewood Symbiote.
Repeat.
